settings.editor: We deliver end-to-end solutions — from rapid deployment to round-the-clock field support — so your projects never lose momentum.
Short or long-term access to 500+ machines — excavators, dozers, loaders, and cranes — all certified and job-ready.
Mobile technicians dispatch within 2 hours for repairs, fluid checks, and servicing — zero downtime guaranteed.
We handle all transport — drop-off, pick-up, and inter-site transfers — using our own fleet of certified lowboy haulers.
Our senior advisors assess your site conditions and recommend the exact machinery configuration.

We've spent 25 years perfecting every aspect of the heavy equipment rental experience — from the first phone call to the final pickup. Our clients don't just rent machines; they gain a strategic partner.
Rigorous pre-deployment servicing ensures maximum performance and practically eliminates on-site failure.
Choose from a massive roster of late-model, cutting-edge equipment built by the world's most trusted manufacturers.
Our advanced logistics network guarantees rapid on-site equipment delivery exactly when you demand it.
Quick answers to common questions about our rental process, equipment details, and delivery logistics.

sg_accordion_list.sg_accordion_list_title: Can I rent equipment for a long term project?
sg_accordion_list.sg_accordion_list_content: Absolutely. RigRent offers flexible long term rental agreements ranging from one month to several years. Long term contracts come with priority fleet access, dedicated account management and significantly reduced daily rates the longer your rental period runs.

sg_accordion_list.sg_accordion_list_title: Is insurance included in the rental price?
sg_accordion_list.sg_accordion_list_content: Basic equipment insurance is included in all standard RigRent rental agreements at no additional cost. We also offer extended coverage options for high risk environments, remote locations and large scale projects that require additional protection and liability.

sg_accordion_list.sg_accordion_list_title: Can I inspect the equipment before renting?
sg_accordion_list.sg_accordion_list_content: es, we encourage all clients to inspect equipment before confirming their rental. You can visit our depot during business hours or request a pre-delivery inspection report complete with photos and a full 50-point condition checklist for every machine.

sg_accordion_list.sg_accordion_list_title: Do you offer training for equipment operators?
sg_accordion_list.sg_accordion_list_content: Yes, RigRent provides certified operator training programs for all major equipment categories. Our training is conducted by industry experienced professionals and covers safe operation, daily inspection procedures and emergency protocols to keep your team compliant and project running safely.
